points.description: Monotone score→audio mapping, seconds, clipped to the score end. The SINGLE source of truth: the client derives alphaTab FlatSyncPoints from this (simplified + terminal-anchored). Empty when status=failed.

anchorCount.description: Number of manual anchors used; > 0 means region-wise refinement (sync_via_mrmsdtw_with_anchors) rather than a single global solve.

residualRmsMs.description: RMS deviation of the DTW path from its own global linear fit — how much a single-offset method would miss.

pathStability.description: Fraction of the path whose local slope stays near the median (1.0 = rock steady).

referenceRender.description: How the MIDI reference was rendered for DTW.

snapMaxMs.description: Largest applied onset snap shift, ms (relative to the median shift).

snapMeanAbsMs.description: Mean absolute applied snap shift, ms.

featureRate.description: DTW feature rate in Hz; 100 = 10 ms frames (fast-song profile).

alpha.description: Chroma weight in the finest-level DTW cost; 1-alpha goes to DLNCO onsets.

thresholdRec.description: Max area of a MrMsDTW constraint rectangle.

dlncoDecayFrames.description: DLNCO onset decay length in frames.

gridSec.description: Score-axis spacing of the emitted grid, before bar/beat times are unioned in.

snapMode.description: Which musical positions the onset snapper was allowed to de-jitter.

snapCandidates.description: Points that were both a musical position and carried a notated attack.

snapMeasured.description: Candidates where an onset peak was actually found.

snapAppliedCount.description: Candidates whose shift agreed with the local median and was applied.

snapRejectedCount.description: Candidates whose shift disagreed with its neighbours (a likely wrong-subdivision snap) and was discarded.

snapGlobalMedianMs.description: Median raw shift, subtracted from every point so snapping never moves the song's global offset.

snapWindowMs.description: Half-width of the onset search, derived from the score tempo.
